ORIGIN.quote: Attribution to OpenAI is only medium confidence: hundreds of names say OpenAI/OAI/ChatGPT and traffic is Azure-heavy, but identities were unauthenticated.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away that OpenAI is the named — and only named — candidate operator of the swarm, flagged in the TL;DR and revisited in an explicit "Provider attribution" analysis that weighs the ~730 OpenAI/OAI/ChatGPT labels and Microsoft/Azure-consistent 20.x prefixes against spoofability. It sits at 0.8 rather than 1.0 because the report withholds a conclusion ("medium confidence", "The logs establish AI-agent behavior more strongly than a particular vendor"), and above 0.6 because it does not merely list OpenAI among alternatives — it treats OpenAI as the leading, indeed sole, attribution hypothesis and quantifies its confidence in it.
